title: Switch
summary: The switch track squeezes to 96% when pressed, hover only applies on devices that can hover, and the invisible pointer target is now 44 x 28 for the default size (4px of padding on every side). An optional description can sit under the label. The thumb is deliberately not stretched on press.
why: Press feedback on toggles is standard in HeroUI, Mantine and Apple's switch; the thumb stretch was tried and rejected in design/V2-MOTION.md, so only the track scales.
A 36 x 20 target is under the 44px touch recommendation in height; the 4px ring brings the default to 44 x 28 without shifting layout.
HeroUI and Untitled UI toggles support supporting text under the label.

scenarioLabels.gallery-states: All states and sizes (unchanged at rest)
scenarioLabels.toggle-on: Switching on (frame samples: thumb x, track colour)

motion.after: Track scale 1 to .96 in 80ms; back in 200ms, spring. The thumb does not stretch. Disabled switches do not press

states: Switch / pressed (track 96%) for on and off, all sizes (new)
Switch / hit area: sm 40 x 26, default 44 x 28, lg 52 x 32 (annotation)
figmaSteps: Wrap each Switch size in a transparent frame 4px larger on every side (sm 40 x 26, default 44 x 28, lg 52 x 32); the visible track stays 32 x 18 / 36 x 20 / 44 x 24 and layout width is unchanged (ignore auto layout or -4px margins).
Add 'Pressed' variants (on and off): the TRACK only at scale 96% (thumb scales with it as a child; no width change on the thumb). Smart Animate 80ms ease-out down, 200ms Gentle spring back.

Add an optional 'Description' to the labelled Switch: Inter 12px / 16px regular --v2-text-muted #707070, 4px under the label; auto layout horizontal, gap 8px, align top; the label row is as tall as the track (sm 18, default 20, lg 24). Label-left mirrors it. Disabled: text block 50% opacity.

Colours are unchanged: on --semantic-primary #343E55 (hover --semantic-primary-hover #2F384D), off --semantic-primary-surface #EBECEE (hover --semantic-border-layout #E9EAEB), thumb #FFFFFF with the existing shadow.
notes: Description spacing is 4px (matches Radio's actual code) rather than the 2px quoted in the task.
Hover colour changes are now `@media (hover: hover)` only, so they no longer stick after a tap on touch screens.

Hit area implementation: `before:-inset-[6px]`, not `-inset-1`: the offset is measured from the padding box, which excludes the 2px border. Measured with elementFromPoint in Chrome: the ring is 40 x 26 / 44 x 28 / 52 x 32 for sm / default / lg; 3.9px outside hits the switch, 5px outside does not.
